outputs.name: +page
outputs.description: The page renders the shared-projects route, showing sign-in when no actor is present and project creation with the project list, loading, or error state when signed in. Its GitHub connection message appears only when the query string has `github=connected` or `github=failed`.

errors.name: unknown
errors.description: The refresh callback can reject with the reason from `session.check()` because it awaits that call without a catch or narrowing the rejection. The implementation does not specify the rejection value or its runtime name.
